name: OnePageCRM
description: Turn Claude into your CRM assistant. It can summarize your Action Stream, do research, create new contacts, schedule follow-ups, rearrange overdue tasks, log notes after calls, update deals, and build simple dashboards. Let AI handle the admin while you build relationships, close deals, and focus on growing your business with OnePageCRM.

_published_faq.name: How do I add OnePageCRM to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add OnePageCRM to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.onepagecrm.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the OnePageCRM MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: OnePageCRM provides these MCP tools: context, create, describe, feedback, query, and update.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to OnePageCRM?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to OnePageCRM in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
OnePageCRM requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
OnePageCRM is developed by OnePageCRM. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
